feedback.worked_solution:
The function is continuous on the open intervals $(0,3)$, $(3,9)$ and $(9,\infty ).$

Additionally, the function is right-continuous at $x=0.$ Hence, it is continuous on the interval $[0,3).$

Therefore, we can say that the function is continuous on $x\in [0,3)\cup (3,9)\cup (9,\infty ).$
